data.summary:
**When:** [Your Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), during its Reinforcements step.

**Target:** A **TZEENTCH MUTANT** unit of yours that arrives this phase from [Strategic Reserves](vsdata:core-rule/strategic-reserves).

**Effect:** The unit can be placed anywhere more than 6" horizontally from every enemy unit, or more than 8" for a **MONSTER** unit. Either way, it cannot declare a charge for the rest of the turn.
